description: Positional fill semantics for optionals preceding a trailing required: an absent optional is forced to an explicit empty placeholder only when a LATER optional in the run is supplied; absent optionals with no later supplied optional keep their declared defaults.

cases.expected_output:
arg=o1 kind=optional source=default value="d1"
arg=o2 kind=optional source=default value="d2"
arg=req kind=required source=injected value="R"

arg=o1 kind=optional source=injected value=<nil>
arg=o2 kind=optional source=injected value=<nil>
arg=o3 kind=optional source=injected value="third"
arg=req kind=required source=injected value="R"

arg=o1 kind=optional source=injected value=<nil>
arg=o2 kind=optional source=injected value="mid"
arg=o3 kind=optional source=default value="d3"
